title: The package
lines: Inside the package, each memory stack is eight dies on top of each other.

title: Two boards
lines: A gaming graphics card keeps its memory in separate chips around the GPU.
An AI server node has none of them: the memory sits inside each GPU package.

title: Wires
lines: Bandwidth is the clock rate times the number of wires carrying data.
Signals race down every wire at once, so a wider bus moves more bits.

title: Etching a via
lines: A Bosch etch cuts the hole in short cycles of plasma etching and passivation.
Then oxide, a tantalum barrier and a copper seed line the walls, and copper fills it.

title: Substrate
lines: The substrate starts as glass fibre cloth soaked in epoxy, clad in copper foil.
Cut open, it is copper layers in resin, joined by tiny laser drilled vias.
